messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] 2026.03.1 -> prod starting. Rolling flag ff_new_routing from OFF to ON over 30m. Initial cohort: 10%. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-rollout. /toggle ff_new_routing 10%  
jamal: ok i'm watching the canary metrics. prefer 10 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with 8m holds, not a straight 30m ramp. last time 25% caused an error spike.  
kevin: +1 to staged increments. can we add a short health-check at each step: latency p95, error-rate, and qps? if either latency p95 > 350ms or error-rate > 0.7% we pause and rollback.  
maria: agree on thresholds. i'll own rollback decision if the alerts trigger within the next 45m. set canary tag so we can drain gracefully.  
olga: i'll be on pager for the window. will tail prod logs and watch dd dashboards. if we see tail error traces with "kv-cache-evict" tag at 25% i'll thumb the flag off.  
jamal: here's the ramp plan I'm executing now: 
```
/toggle ff_new_routing 10%  # t=0
wait 8m -> evaluate
/toggle ff_new_routing 25% # t=8m
wait 8m -> evaluate
/toggle ff_new_routing 50% # t=16m
wait 8m -> evaluate
/toggle ff_new_routing 100% # t=24m
```
kevin: note for ops: if we pause at any step, set routing pin to previous model-version to avoid mixing behaviors. command to pin: `/pin model-routing v2026.2.9`  
maria: adding quick smoke checks: run 20 synthetic requests across regions eu/us/apac and assert responses contain route hint header `x-rr-route: new` and lat < 300ms.  
olga: logs gating: `grep kv-cache-evict /var/log/prod/*.log | tail -n 50` — i'll run that after we shift to 25%.  
deploy-bot: toggle executed: ff_new_routing -> 10% by jamal (uid: U123).  
jamal: 10% stable for 8m, p95=280ms, errors=0.12%, cpu steady. moving to 25% now. /toggle ff_new_routing 25%  
kevin: watching telemetry — p95 jumped to 410ms on two hosts, small error bump to 0.9%. tagging alert.  
maria: alert looks real. can you dump stack traces from the two hosts? if root cause is unrelated (third-party timeout), we can continue. otherwise rollback.  
olga: stack traces show repeated redis timeouts near kv-cache-evict. correlates with 25% shift.  \jamal: pausing ramp. rolling ff back to 0% to be safe. /toggle ff_new_routing 0%  
deploy-bot: toggle executed: ff_new_routing -> 0% by jamal (uid: U123).  
maria: good call. i'm closing the window and will open a postmortem thread for root cause. leaving flag gated until we have mitigations (kv cache fix or independent rollout for region). :white_check_mark:  
kevin: leaving a quick note for release notes: "2026.03.1: rollout of new routing aborted at 25% due to kv-cache redis timeouts; feature flag remains OFF; fix in progress."  
olga: will monitor overnight and report any regressions. thanks team.
